name: code-pulse
description: Code Pulse is an extension to keep track of your productivity and coding patterns to help you out.
author: BleckWolf25

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only basic metrics tracking is available in untrusted workspaces

productivityDashboard.enableMetricTracki.markdownDescription:
**Enable or disable metric tracking**

When enabled, the extension will track your coding activity, complexity metrics, and productivity patterns.

productivityDashboard.complexityThreshol.markdownDescription:
**Global complexity threshold for warnings**

Code with complexity above this threshold will trigger warnings. This can be overridden per language.

productivityDashboard.trackingInterval.markdownDescription:
**Tracking interval in minutes**

How often the extension collects and processes metrics data.

productivityDashboard.excludedLanguages.markdownDescription:
**File types to exclude from tracking**

Specify file extensions or language IDs to exclude from metrics collection.

productivityDashboard.enableDetailedLogg.markdownDescription:
**Enable detailed debug logging**

⚠️ **Warning**: This may impact performance and should only be enabled for troubleshooting.

productivityDashboard.complexityThreshol.markdownDescription:
**Language-specific complexity thresholds**

Override the global complexity threshold for specific programming languages.

productivityDashboard.languageConfigs.markdownDescription:
**Advanced language-specific configurations**

Detailed configuration for complexity analysis weights, thresholds, and options per language.

productivityDashboard.dataRetentionDays.markdownDescription:
**Number of days to retain metrics data**

📊 Longer retention periods provide better historical analysis but use more storage space.

productivityDashboard.maxStorageSize.markdownDescription:
**Maximum storage size in MB**

💾 Limits the amount of disk space used for metrics storage.

productivityDashboard.theme.markdownDescription:
**Dashboard theme preference**

- `auto`: Follow VS Code theme
- `light`: Always use light theme
- `dark`: Always use dark theme

productivityDashboard.enableNotification.markdownDescription:
**Enable extension notifications**

Show notifications for important events, warnings, and updates.

productivityDashboard.websocket.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Enable WebSocket for real-time updates**

🔄 Provides real-time synchronization between the extension and dashboard views.

productivityDashboard.websocket.fallback.markdownDescription:
**Fallback to polling if WebSocket fails**

🔄 Automatically switch to polling mode if WebSocket connection fails.

productivityDashboard.websocket.updateIn.markdownDescription:
**WebSocket update interval in milliseconds**

⚡ Lower values provide more responsive updates but may impact performance.

productivityDashboard.websocket.maxClien.markdownDescription:
**Maximum number of WebSocket clients**

👥 Limits concurrent dashboard connections to prevent resource exhaustion.

productivityDashboard.websocket.pingInte.markdownDescription:
**WebSocket ping interval in milliseconds**

💓 How often to send keep-alive pings to maintain connection.

productivityDashboard.websocket.connecti.markdownDescription:
**WebSocket connection timeout in milliseconds**

⏱️ Maximum time to wait for connection establishment.

productivityDashboard.analytics.enableAd.markdownDescription:
**Enable advanced analytics features**

📈 Provides detailed insights into coding patterns and productivity trends.

productivityDashboard.analytics.enableTr.markdownDescription:
**Enable trend analysis**

📊 Analyzes productivity trends over time to identify patterns.

productivityDashboard.analytics.enablePe.markdownDescription:
**Enable performance benchmarking**

🏆 Compares your performance against historical data and best practices.

productivityDashboard.analytics.enableTe.markdownDescription:
**Enable team collaboration metrics**

👥 Tracks team-wide productivity metrics (requires team setup).

productivityDashboard.analytics.enableCo.markdownDescription:
**Enable code health scoring**

🏥 Provides overall code quality and maintainability scores.

productivityDashboard.analytics.enableHi.markdownDescription:
**Enable historical data analysis**

📚 Analyzes long-term trends and patterns in your coding behavior.

productivityDashboard.analytics.enableRe.markdownDescription:
**Enable performance regression detection**

🔍 Automatically detects when productivity or code quality decreases.

productivityDashboard.analytics.enablePr.markdownDescription:
**Enable productivity pattern recognition**

🧠 Identifies patterns in your most productive coding sessions.

productivityDashboard.dashboard.enableDr.markdownDescription:
**Enable drill-down capabilities in charts**

🔍 Click on chart elements to view detailed breakdowns.

productivityDashboard.dashboard.enableFi.markdownDescription:
**Enable filtering and search functionality**

🔎 Filter dashboard data by date ranges, languages, and other criteria.

productivityDashboard.dashboard.enableEx.markdownDescription:
**Enable export options for different formats**

💾 Export dashboard data as CSV, JSON, or PDF reports.

productivityDashboard.dashboard.enableGo.markdownDescription:
**Enable goal setting and tracking features**

🎯 Set and track productivity goals with progress indicators.

productivityDashboard.dashboard.refreshI.markdownDescription:
**Dashboard refresh interval in milliseconds**

🔄 How often the dashboard updates its data display.

productivityDashboard.reporting.enablePD.markdownDescription:
**Enable PDF report generation**

📄 Generate comprehensive PDF reports of your productivity metrics.

productivityDashboard.reporting.enableSc.markdownDescription:
**Enable scheduled reports**

📅 Automatically generate and send reports at specified intervals.

productivityDashboard.reporting.enableTe.markdownDescription:
**Enable team summary reports**

👥 Generate reports summarizing team-wide productivity metrics.

productivityDashboard.reporting.enableCI.markdownDescription:
**Enable CI/CD integration reports**

🔧 Integrate productivity metrics with your CI/CD pipeline.

productivityDashboard.configVersion.markdownDescription:
**Configuration version**

Internal configuration version for migration purposes.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
